name: Okonogi Tokihiko
source:
The treacherous prime minister who only thinks about his selfish gains without thinking about others.

[spoiler]In truth, he is the one supporting the country behind the shadows, knowing full well that it will only lead to his own death.

During the palace raid, the main party finally confronts Okonogi, where he tells them the truth that he never was corrupted and only followed the late queen's orders, and as a true warrior thought only about his country, sacrificing himself in the process.[/spoiler]
